_note: Online play (the Hive milestone). Server-authoritative raids, squads, the shared squad vault. Times s, distances m. See docs/gdd/hive-milestone.md.

matchmaking.note: gear score = value of what you carry in; bands keep fresh hosts away from fully kitted squads, widening after 45 s in queue

squad.lootRule: free within the squad; ping to call items

vault.note: a shared squad stash next to each personal stash; deposits and withdrawals are logged so squads can see who took what

pvp.note: no kill feed: you learn who died by what you find

peerToPeer._note: Online & Backend: what the free build actually runs. No paid server: the squad leader's browser hosts the raid over WebRTC and runs the creatures, so its upload carries every host. Hence fewer hosts and a lower send rate than the dedicated-server targets above; raise them when a server exists.

bots.note: rival host bots (rivals.json) fill empty slots up to botsFillTo; they leave as humans join late
